questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that only people with disabled parking permits can park in these spaces.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign showing the fastest legal speed for the road. During bad weather like rain, snow, or ice, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a bus stop ahead.
There is a stop sign ahead.
There is a caution sign ahead.
You must stop if other cars stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a stop sign ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming up ahead so you can prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready for red lights, yellow lights, and cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down and avoid sudden braking or sharp turns. Keep a safe distance from the car ahead of you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must or must not do. This sign means you cannot park at this location at any time.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When driving on a road with multiple lanes, make space for vehicles entering the roadway. Move to another lane if it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones ahead. This sign tells you that construction will redirect traffic from the normal route. Be ready to follow a different path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending ahead. You must move your vehicle to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Get ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the right lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill grade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a Y intersection is ahead. You must turn either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that a yield sign is coming. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down and be ready to stop at the intersection. Let other drivers and pedestrians pass first. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you to watch for hazards ahead and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. HOV lanes are for buses and cars with at least a driver and one passenger, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Yield the right-of-way to all vehicles and pedestrians. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm upward, they are signaling a right turn. Adjust your driving if you are following this driver.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns of bicycles crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road ahead will become a divided highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: A one-way sign shows that traffic can only move in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of multiple curves ahead on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that traffic may come from the opposite direction.
